description: Capture a styled screenshot of the current page at a fixed viewport, written under .swebsy-agent/screenshots/. Returns the file path. Scope it with `targetPath` when verifying ONE section — a whole-page PNG downscales so far that component detail is unreadable.

selectionOnly.description: Capture only the selected component instead of the full page.

targetPath.description: Optional. Capture only the component at this read_page target path (e.g. [3] for the fourth section) instead of the whole page.

name: swebsy_capture
